nativelink.Log lines: journal lines from the nix-cache units in the time range.
nativelink.Errors: priority ≤ 3 lines from the nix-cache units; 0 is the expected state.
nativelink.Uploads: NARs accepted by the nix_cache HTTP endpoint (PUT) in the range.
nativelink.Downloads: NARs served to nix clients (GET .nar) in the range.
nativelink.Narinfo: narinfo lookups answered; a miss is a 404 below.
nativelink.404s: narinfo or NAR requests for paths this cache does not hold; expected on a fresh cache.
nativelink.By node: nix-cache requests per second, one series per host.
nativelink.Operations: nix-cache operations by kind; empty until the cache serves a client with the metric exporter on.
nativelink.Push failures: nl-watch-store pushes the cache rejected; anything above 0 means a path is missing from R2.
nativelink.Active nodes: hosts whose nativelink unit logged in the last 5 minutes.
nativelink.Lines/min: scheduler, CAS and worker log volume; a flat line is a quiet scheduler, not a dead one.
nativelink.Log volume: nativelink.service journal lines per minute, by severity.
nativelink.Events by host: nativelink events per minute, one series per host.
nativelink.Actions completed / s: remote actions the scheduler marked complete, per second, 30 s buckets.
nativelink.Action time, avg — queue vs total: mean seconds an action waited in the queue versus its total time; a widening gap is worker starvation.
nativelink.Stage time, avg — fetch / execute / uplo: mean seconds per worker stage; fetch is CAS input download, upload is result publication.
nativelink.Output size per action, avg: mean bytes of outputs per completed action.
nativelink.Peak memory per action, avg: mean of the per-action peak RSS reported by the worker.
nativelink.Reads served by the fast tier — %: share of CAS reads answered from the local fast tier without touching R2; higher is cheaper.
nativelink.Tier ops / s by result: CAS reads per second split by tier and hit or miss.
nativelink.Read throughput by tier: bytes per second read from the fast and slow tiers.
nativelink.Write throughput by tier: bytes per second written per tier; empty while the slow tier is read-through (pushToR2 = False).
nativelink.RPC latency, avg by method: mean gRPC latency per REAPI method; Execute includes queue time.
nativelink.Connected workers: workers currently registered with the scheduler.
nativelink.Actions completed / s by worker: completed actions per second, one series per worker id.
nativelink.Action failures / s by worker: actions that failed on the worker (non-zero exit or infrastructure error), per second.
nativelink.CAS fast-tier fill — %: local fast tier bytes used over its configured cap; eviction starts near 100.
nativelink.Fast-tier fill by host: bytes held in the local fast tier, per host.
nativelink.Fast-tier inserts by host: bytes per second inserted into the fast tier.
nativelink.Fast-tier evictions by host: bytes per second evicted from the fast tier; sustained eviction means the tier is too small for the working set.
nativelink.All errors: every error-level line from the nativelink units in the range, newest first.

fleet-overview.Hosts reporting: hosts that shipped a metric in the last 2 minutes; red when none.
fleet-overview.Fleet load avg: mean 1-minute load average across reporting hosts.
fleet-overview.Fleet memory used: used memory over total, fleet-wide, latest sample.
fleet-overview.Errors (5m): error-level journal lines across the fleet in the last 5 minutes.
fleet-overview.OTel points / min: metric data points landing in ClickHouse per minute; a drop means a collector is down.
fleet-overview.DNS queries / s: CoreDNS requests per second, fleet-wide, last 2 minutes.
fleet-overview.Load average (1m) by host: 1-minute load average per host; the dashed thresholds are the load alert levels.
fleet-overview.Memory used by host: bytes of memory in the used state per host.
fleet-overview.Paging ops / s by host: page-in and page-out operations per second; sustained paging is memory pressure.
fleet-overview.Disk I/O rate by host: bytes per second read and written across block devices, per host.
fleet-overview.Filesystem used by host: used share per mounted filesystem, excluding /nix; red above 90 %.
fleet-overview.Network throughput by host: bytes per second received and transmitted on non-loopback interfaces.
fleet-overview.Network errors + drops: interface errors and dropped packets per second; the expected value is 0.
fleet-overview.CoreDNS queries / s: DNS requests per second per resolver host.
fleet-overview.DNS cache hit rate: share of DNS answers served from CoreDNS's cache.
fleet-overview.NativeLink actions completed / s: remote actions completed per second across schedulers.
fleet-overview.Error log (last hour): error-level journal lines fleet-wide, newest first; filter by host above.

host-drilldown.CPU time by state: CPU seconds per second by state (user, system, idle, iowait…), stacked across cores.
host-drilldown.Load averages (1m / 5m / 15m): the three load averages for the selected host.
host-drilldown.Memory by state: memory bytes by state: used, free, cached, buffered.
host-drilldown.Paging (swap I/O): paging operations per second by direction and type.
host-drilldown.Disk I/O by device: bytes per second per block device and direction.
host-drilldown.Network I/O by interface: bytes per second per interface and direction, loopback excluded.
host-drilldown.Network errors + drops: errors and dropped packets per interface; expected 0.
host-drilldown.Log rate by severity: journal lines per minute by severity for this host.
host-drilldown.Recent logs: the host's journal, newest first, 500 lines.

service-health.Hosts UP: hosts with a metric in the last 2 minutes.
service-health.Errors (5m): error-level journal lines in the last 5 minutes, fleet-wide.
service-health.Metric points / min: metric points ingested per minute over the last 5 minutes.
service-health.Log lines / min: journal lines ingested per minute over the last 5 minutes.
service-health.Hosts, last seen: when each host last shipped a metric; down after 120 s of silence.
service-health.Units with errors, last hour: systemd units that logged errors in the last hour, most first.
service-health.Metric points ingested / min: metric points per minute arriving in ClickHouse; a cliff is a dead collector.
service-health.Log lines ingested / min: journal lines per minute arriving in ClickHouse.

clickhouse-internals.MergeTree size: bytes on disk across MergeTree tables.
clickhouse-internals.Active parts: active data parts; thousands means merges are behind.
clickhouse-internals.Max parts/partition: largest part count in one partition; inserts are delayed near 300 and refused at 3000.
clickhouse-internals.Memory tracked: bytes the server's memory tracker accounts for.
clickhouse-internals.Delayed inserts: inserts throttled because a partition has too many parts.
clickhouse-internals.jemalloc resident vs allocated: allocator resident versus allocated bytes; a wide gap is fragmentation.
clickhouse-internals.OS free (no cache): free memory as the OS sees it, excluding page cache.
clickhouse-internals.Background merges: merges running in the background pool.
clickhouse-internals.Merge time: milliseconds spent merging per second of wall time.
clickhouse-internals.Parts: active vs outdated: active parts versus parts waiting to be dropped after a merge.
clickhouse-internals.Read bytes/sec: bytes read from disk per second.
clickhouse-internals.Write bytes/sec: bytes written to disk per second.
clickhouse-internals.Read time: milliseconds spent in disk reads per second.
clickhouse-internals.Write time: milliseconds spent in disk writes per second.
clickhouse-internals.Open FDs (R/W): open file descriptors for reading and writing.
clickhouse-internals.By type: network connections by type (TCP, HTTP, interserver).
clickhouse-internals.Fetch / Send: replicated fetches and sends in flight.
clickhouse-internals.Background pool: threads busy in the background pools.
clickhouse-internals.CPU time: CPU milliseconds consumed per second of wall time.
clickhouse-internals.Watches: Keeper watches registered by this server.
clickhouse-internals.Ops/sec (get/set/create/txn): Keeper operations per second by kind.
clickhouse-internals.Requests by node: Keeper requests per second per node.
clickhouse-internals.Compressed read/sec: bytes per second read from compressed blocks.
clickhouse-internals.S3 write latency: milliseconds per S3 PUT to the R2 tier.
clickhouse-internals.IO wait: milliseconds per second the server waited on IO.

clickhouse-keeper.Nodes reporting: Keeper nodes that shipped metrics in the last 2 minutes.
clickhouse-keeper.Synced followers: followers in sync with the leader; on a solo Keeper this is 0 by design.
clickhouse-keeper.Leader latency: mean request latency on the leader, milliseconds.
clickhouse-keeper.Commits/sec: Raft log entries committed per second.
clickhouse-keeper.Data size: bytes held by the znode store.
clickhouse-keeper.Commit rate per node: committed Raft entries per second, per node.
clickhouse-keeper.Inter-node divergence: spread of committed index across nodes; 0 on a solo Keeper.
clickhouse-keeper.Raft lag (target - committed): entries between the target and committed index.
clickhouse-keeper.Max latency by node: worst request latency per node in the bucket.
clickhouse-keeper.Latency spread: max minus average latency; a widening spread is a slow disk.
clickhouse-keeper.Leader / Follower by node: 1 for the leader, 0 for followers, per node.
clickhouse-keeper.Ephemerals: ephemeral znodes, one per live session that created one.
clickhouse-keeper.Key arena: bytes in the key arena; empty when the Keeper build does not export it.
clickhouse-keeper.Commit log cache: bytes of commit log held in memory.
clickhouse-keeper.Sessions with watches: sessions that hold at least one watch.
clickhouse-keeper.TCP rejected: connections rejected by the Keeper; expected 0.

coredns.Queries / s, fleet: DNS requests per second across resolvers, last 2 minutes.
coredns.SERVFAIL / s: answers with rcode SERVFAIL per second; expected 0.
coredns.Nodes serving: hosts answering DNS in the last 2 minutes.
coredns.HC failures: upstream health-check failures in the last 5 minutes.
coredns.By node: requests per second per resolver host.
coredns.By type (A, AAAA, PTR, SRV...): requests per second by query type.
coredns.By RCODE: answers per second by response code, stacked.
coredns.NXDOMAIN + SERVFAIL: negative and failed answers per second, by node.
coredns.Responses by plugin: answers per second attributed to each CoreDNS plugin.
coredns.Hit rate: share of answers served from cache.
coredns.Hits by type: cache hits per second by record type.
coredns.Misses by node: cache misses per second per node.
coredns.All upstreams broken: 1 while every upstream fails its health check.
coredns.Conn cache hits vs misses: forwarder connection reuse versus new connections.
coredns.Template matches (CNAME): answers synthesised by the template plugin (flat s4.gl names).
coredns.By family (IPv4/IPv6): requests per second by address family.

log-explorer.Log volume by severity: journal lines per minute by severity for the selected hosts and units.
log-explorer.Error count by host: error-level lines per host in the range.
log-explorer.Error count by unit: error-level lines per systemd unit in the range, top 15.
log-explorer.Top error messages: most frequent error messages in the range, truncated to 120 characters.
log-explorer.Log stream: the journal, newest first, 500 lines; the Search box matches the raw body.

network-topology.TX by host: bytes transmitted per second per host, loopback excluded.
network-topology.RX by host: bytes received per second per host, loopback excluded.
network-topology.Errors by host: interface errors per second per host; expected 0.
network-topology.Drops by host: dropped packets per second per host; expected 0.
network-topology.Tailscale TX: bytes per second transmitted on tailscale0.
network-topology.Tailscale RX: bytes per second received on tailscale0.

forgejo-activity.Goroutines: live goroutines in the Forgejo process.
forgejo-activity.Heap alloc: bytes allocated on the Go heap.
forgejo-activity.Errors (6h): error-level lines from forgejo.service in the last 6 hours.
forgejo-activity.Git pushes: git-receive-pack operations logged in the range.
forgejo-activity.Git fetches: git-upload-pack operations logged in the range.
forgejo-activity.Process CPU, 2 min: CPU seconds consumed by Forgejo in the last 2 minutes.
forgejo-activity.Heap (alloc / sys): Go heap allocated versus obtained from the OS.
forgejo-activity.Pushes and fetches: git operations per 5 minutes by kind.
forgejo-activity.SSH vs HTTP: git operations per 5 minutes by transport.
forgejo-activity.Log volume: forgejo.service lines per minute by severity.
forgejo-activity.Errors: error-level lines from forgejo.service, newest first.
forgejo-activity.Recent git activity: pushes, fetches and ref updates, newest first.
